translations.web: A man’s spirit will sustain him in sickness, but a crushed spirit, who can bear?
translations.bsb: The spirit of a man can endure his sickness, but who can survive a broken spirit?
translations.kjv: The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity; but a wounded spirit who can bear?
translations.asv: The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity; But a broken spirit who can bear?
